He writes his reports careful and precise.
He writes his reports carefully and precisely.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The error in the sentence lies in the use of the adjective 'careful'. The sentence describes the action (verb) 'writes'. To modify a verb, we must use adverbs. Since 'precisely' is an adverb, the parallel word connected by 'and' must also be an adverb. The adverb form of 'careful' is 'carefully'.

Solution (HI):
वाक्य में त्रुटि विशेषण (adjective) 'careful' के उपयोग में है। यह वाक्य क्रिया (verb) 'writes' का वर्णन करता है। क्रिया की विशेषता बताने के लिए, हमें क्रियाविशेषणों (adverbs) का उपयोग करना चाहिए। चूंकि 'precisely' एक क्रियाविशेषण है, इसलिए 'and' द्वारा जोड़ा गया समानांतर शब्द भी क्रियाविशेषण होना चाहिए। 'careful' का क्रियाविशेषण रूप 'carefully' है।

Short Trick:
Action verbs are always modified by adverbs (typically ending in '-ly'). Both modifiers joined by 'and' must take the same adverbial form: carefully and precisely.

Final Answer: $\text{He writes his reports carefully and precisely.}$

solution:
Solution (EN):
The blank precedes the word 'owl'. Since 'owl' begins with a vowel sound ($\text{/aʊ/}$), we must use the indefinite article 'an' before it. 'The' is incorrect because the speaker is introducing a generic owl, not a specific one previously mentioned.

Solution (HI):
रिक्त स्थान 'owl' शब्द से पहले है। चूँकि 'owl' एक स्वर ध्वनि (vowel sound) से शुरू होता है, इसलिए हमें इसके पहले अनिश्चित उपपद (indefinite article) 'an' का उपयोग करना चाहिए। 'The' गलत है क्योंकि यहाँ किसी सामान्य उल्लू की बात हो रही है, न कि किसी पूर्व-निर्दिष्ट विशेष उल्लू की।

Short Trick:
Words starting with a vowel sound (a, e, i, o, u sounds) take the article 'an'.

Final Answer: $\text{an}$

section: Test of English Language and Comprehension
q_en: Out of the four alternatives, choose the sentence which is grammatically correct.
q_hi: Out of the four alternatives, choose the sentence which is grammatically correct.
op_en: She sings more beautifuller than anyone in the choir does.
She sings beautifuler than anyone in the choir.
She sings beautiful than anyone in the choir.
She sings more beautifully than anyone in the choir.
op_hi: She sings more beautifuller than anyone in the choir does.
She sings beautifuler than anyone in the choir.
She sings beautiful than anyone in the choir.
She sings more beautifully than anyone in the choir.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The sentence requires a modifier for the verb 'sings'. To describe a verb, an adverb is needed, which is 'beautifully'. To form the comparative degree of an adverb ending in '-ly', we use the word 'more' before it. Thus, 'more beautifully' is the correct grammatically structured form. Words like 'beautifuller' and 'beautifuler' do not exist in standard English.

Solution (HI):
वाक्य में 'sings' (गाना) क्रिया की विशेषता बताने के लिए एक संशोधक की आवश्यकता है। क्रिया का वर्णन करने के लिए एक क्रियाविशेषण (adverb) की आवश्यकता होती है, जो 'beautifully' है। '-ly' पर समाप्त होने वाले क्रियाविशेषण की तुलनात्मक डिग्री (comparative degree) बनाने के लिए, हम इसके पहले 'more' शब्द का उपयोग करते हैं। इस प्रकार, 'more beautifully' सही व्याकरणिक रूप है। 'beautifuller' और 'beautifuler' जैसे शब्द अंग्रेजी में मौजूद नहीं हैं।

Short Trick:
The comparative form for adverbs ending in '-ly' is made by adding 'more' (e.g., more beautifully, more carefully). Do not use '-er' suffixes on them.

Final Answer: $\text{She sings more beautifully than anyone in the choir.}$

q_en:
In the given question, a statement divided into different segments is given. Rearrange all the segments to form a coherent statement.

is a favourite spot to relax and enjoy nature (A) / surrounded by lush greenery (B) / for locals and tourists alike (C) / this beautiful park (D)
q_hi:
In the given question, a statement divided into different segments is given. Rearrange all the segments to form a coherent statement.

is a favourite spot to relax and enjoy nature (A) / surrounded by lush greenery (B) / for locals and tourists alike (C) / this beautiful park (D)
solution:
Solution (EN):
To form a coherent sentence, we must first identify the subject. Part (D) 'this beautiful park' acts as the main subject. Part (B) 'surrounded by lush greenery' is an adjectival phrase modifying the subject. Part (A) contains the main verb and predicate 'is a favourite spot to relax and enjoy nature'. Finally, Part (C) 'for locals and tourists alike' concludes the sentence by identifying who enjoys the spot. Thus, the correct and logical sequence is D - B - A - C.

Solution (HI):
एक सुसंगत वाक्य बनाने के लिए, हमें सबसे पहले विषय (subject) की पहचान करनी होगी। भाग (D) 'this beautiful park' मुख्य विषय के रूप में कार्य करता है। भाग (B) 'surrounded by lush greenery' एक विशेषण वाक्यांश है जो विषय की विशेषता बताता है। भाग (A) में मुख्य क्रिया और विधेय 'is a favourite spot to relax and enjoy nature' शामिल है। अंत में, भाग (C) 'for locals and tourists alike' यह बताकर वाक्य का समापन करता है कि इस स्थान का आनंद कौन लेता है। इस प्रकार, सही और तार्किक क्रम D - B - A - C है।

Short Trick:
Find the main noun/subject first. 'this beautiful park' (D) is the only logical starting point among the choices. DBAC forms a complete, meaningful sentence.

Final Answer: $\text{DBAC}$

The antonym of the word “lowering” as used in the passage is _____.
solution:
Solution (EN):
In the context of the passage, the word 'lowering' means to reduce or make less in amount (e.g., lowering demand). The exact opposite (antonym) of reducing or making something less is making it greater in size or amount, which is 'increasing'. Words like 'decreasing' and 'reducing' act as synonyms here.

Solution (HI):
गद्यांश के संदर्भ में, 'lowering' शब्द का अर्थ है मात्रा में कम करना या घटाना (जैसे, मांग को कम करना)। किसी चीज़ को कम करने या घटाने का ठीक विपरीत (विलोम) उसे आकार या मात्रा में बढ़ाना है, जो कि 'increasing' (बढ़ाना) है। 'decreasing' और 'reducing' जैसे शब्द यहाँ पर्यायवाची (synonyms) के रूप में कार्य करते हैं।

Short Trick:
Lowering = reducing. The antonym (opposite) of reducing is increasing.

Final Answer: $\text{increasing}$
